title: 2015 AMC 12B 2
statement: Marie does three equally time-consuming tasks in a row without taking breaks. She begins the first task at \(1{:}00\) PM and finishes the second task at \(2{:}40\) PM. When does she finish the third task?

solutions.text:
The first two tasks together take \(100\) minutes, so each task takes \(50\) minutes.

The third task finishes \(50\) minutes after \(2{:}40\) PM, at \(3{:}30\) PM.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The first two tasks span \(1{:}00\) to \(2{:}40,\) which is \(100\) minutes
Divide by \(2\) to get one task’s length, then add it after \(2{:}40\)
